text: Shopee's GMV grew faster. In FY2025, Shopee's GMV rose 26.8% year-on-year, from US$100.5 billion in 2024 to US$127.4 billion in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.99-100]. Grab's deliveries GMV grew 21%, from $11,724 million in 2024 to $14,236 million in 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.96].

Confirmed: Shopee's GMV grew ~26.8% (vs. ~21.4% for Grab's deliveries GMV), making Shopee's GMV growth faster in FY2025.

- Shopee GMV: $100.5B (2024) → $127.4B (2025), +26.8% [Sea, FY2025, p.99-100]
- Grab Deliveries GMV: $11,724M (2024) → $14,236M (2025), +21% [Grab, FY2025, p.96]
